initSetupThereBeDesktop_aria: If you are a Mobile user, we would recommend accessing Telstra Optimiser on Desktop for the best screen reader and keyboard navigation support.
pingTestFailedMessage: Press $t(setup:stepsContinue) to use default settings, which will prevent other usage types from interrupting your priority activities when they are detected.
pingTestFailedMessage2: To rerun this tests, use $t(setup:stepsTryAgain) or run $t(branding:pingOptimiser) later from the Congestion Control option in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) section.
pingTestFailedMessage2_aria: To rerun this tests, use $t(setup:stepsTryAgain) or run $t(branding:pingOptimiser) later from the Congestion Control option in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) section.
pingTestFailedTip: <bold>Good, it looks like your ping is already stable when the connection is busy.</bold>
pingTestIntroMessage: This is done by repeatedly measuring your delay (known as ping) whilst simulating busy household use.
pingTestIntroMessageTip: These tests will take up to three minutes.
pingTestIntroTip: $t(branding:dumaosName_short) can improve your gaming & video conferencing experience, by applying the best network priority settings for your connection.
pingTestResultMessage: Press $t(setup:stepsOptimise) to reduce your ping by <bold>{{diff}}ms</bold> during busy times. This will help reduce lag in games or delays in video calls.
pingTestResultTip: Optimizing your ping slightly reduces your useable internet speeds for others. This only happens while your priority activities are in progress.
prioritiseGamingTip: By prioritizing Gaming you can reduce frustrating lag by putting your gaming traffic first and only connecting to nearby servers.
prioritiseWorkTip: By prioritizing Work From Home apps, you can prevent interruptions to your online meetings caused by other internet usage in the household.
searchCurrent_no_place: Press $t(setup:setLocation) to enter your nearest city or town (e.g. {{example_city}}).
searchForHomeTip: To aim for lower in-game ping times, $t(branding:dumaosName_short) provides a $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.geofilter) feature. It uses your location to force supported games to connect to servers near you.
setupCompleteMessage: All done! $t(branding:dumaosName_short) has been set up with the following settings:
speedTestConfirm: $t(branding:dumaosName_short) will use these speed settings to prioritize your connection. You can adjust them any time after setup by visiting Settings in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) section.
speedTestFinishedTip: If these speed settings don't look right, press $t(setup:stepsTestAgain)
speedTestIntroMessage: This test will take a short amount of time.
speedTestIntroTip: $t(branding:dumaosName_short) can optimize your gaming experience by testing your speed.
speedTestPreConfirmTip_wap: If your connection often performs above or below these speeds, use the $t(setup:speedTestPreConfirm_no) option.
speedTestPreConfirm_current_wap: Your detected internet plan speeds are:
speedTestPreConfirm_desc_wap: To effectively prioritise your important internet use, $t(branding:dumaosName_short) needs your maximum connection speeds for its settings.
speedTestResultTip: Do these bandwidth speeds look correct?
speedTestRunningTip: To get the most accurate setting, perform this test whilst there is minimal use of the internet.
welcomeMessageLine1: You're moments away from unlocking a set of features built to reduce lag and optimize your home network.
welcomeMessageLine1_wap: $t(branding:dumaosName_long) lets you prioritise your internet connection. Choose what's most important to you, whether that be your work, play or both.
welcomeMessageLine2_wap: This setup will find the best settings for your connection and preferences.
